title: SceneAxi identity records (v1)
description: User, RoleAssignment, and Session records for the SceneAxi identity plane. schemaVersion is the contract major; consumers MUST refuse major mismatches rather than silently migrate. Two shapes are load-bearing: a user record carries no role property, so the admin role is structurally unclaimable from a client; and a session stores only a SHA-256 token digest, never a raw token. Behavior lives in packages/auth; configuration in docs/auth-credits.md.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit timezone. Timezone-less values refuse.

user.title: User
user.description: An identity record. Deliberately carries NO role property: a role must never ride on a record a client can write. A payload containing role, roles, isAdmin, or admin is refused outright rather than sanitized, so a privilege-escalation attempt cannot look like success.

email.description: Address shape only. Ownership and verification are the injected Better Auth adapter's job.

disabled.description: A disabled user fails every role guard, including admin.

roleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment
roleAssignment.description: A server-derived role. Never accepted from a client payload. The admin role may only originate from the admin-env source, which resolves exactly one captain email from SCENEAXI_ADMIN_EMAIL.

role.description: The complete role vocabulary. There is no third role and no hierarchy.

source.description: How the role was arrived at. Only admin-env may yield admin.

session.title: Session
session.description: A session bound to exactly one surface. tokenDigest is a SHA-256 hex digest so a leaked session row cannot be replayed as a credential. The kids surface is enumerated so it can be refused by name; it is never served.

surface.description: Sessions never span surfaces. kids is listed only so the identity port can refuse it by name.

tokenDigest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the session token. The fixed width means a raw token cannot land in this field by accident.
